title: Mistral Large 4 builds a live orbital tracker
summary: Mistral showed Mistral Large 4 building Orbital Trace, a real-time 3D tracker of about 19,000 satellites and debris objects. The model then tested the app like a user, sped it up, and passed a verification check.
